{{Chapter Infobox |chapterName = Even When Divinity Remains Silent |image = Rinascita Emblem.png|Rinascita Chapter Chronorift Metropolis Emblem.png|Chronorift Metropolis Chapter |type = Main |prev = Chapter I |next = Chapter III }} '''Even When Divinity Remains Silent''' is the [[Main Quests|Main Quest]] chapter set in [[Rinascita]]. ==List of Acts== * Prologue - [[Through the Sea Thou Break]] * Act I - [[The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes]] * Act II - [[Veils Off in Sun or Shadow]] * Act III - [[What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing]] * Interlude - [[Old Man and the Whale]] * Act IV - [[The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier]] * Act V - [[Shadow of Glory]] * Act VI - [[Flames of Heart]] * Act VII - [[Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens]] * Segue - [[Rust, Sword and the Sun]] * Act VIII - [[By Sun's Burning Hand]] * Act IX - [[By Moon's Fated Light]] * Act X - [[The Bygone Shall Always Return]] * Act XI - [[Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides]] * Segue: Afterstory - [[A Stranger in a Strange Land]] * Act XII - [[Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands]] * Segue - [[Flowing Starlight in the Iris]] ==Summary== ===Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break=== {{Quest Description|Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.}} ===Act I - The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes=== {{Quest Description|After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.}} ===Act II - Veils Off in Sun or Shadow=== {{Quest Description|To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deeper you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...}} ===Act III - What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing=== {{Quest Description|Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Pentinent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery... The long-awaited Carnevale is finally set to begin. Together with your friends, you are ready to thwart the Fractsidus' schemes during the celebration...}} ===Interlude - Old Man and the Whale=== {{Quest Description|Sunshine, beach, ocean… and fish! Rinascita, surrounded entirely by the sea, thrives on its love for fishing. A young man named Ishmael will guide you to the Riccioli Islands, a fishing paradise like no other... A sailor named Starbuck has fallen into mental turmoil—rumor has it, a fish drove him to this state... Here, all fish gather—and since whales are also considered "fish", then... A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again... In a storm long ago, a captain and a whale sank beneath the waves together. Now, a similar storm rages, and the whale roams the sea once more… The sea has calmed, but Captain Ahab and his crew are gone. Ishmael, who first brought you to the Riccioli Islands, seems to be studying the relics left behind by the legendary captain…}} ===Act IV - The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier=== {{Quest Description|After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers.
Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...}} ===Act V - Shadow of Glory=== {{Quest Description|The Maiden left the tower without saying goodbye. Follow her trail to the land of glory. Seek victory in the city of glory while searching for tales hidden in shadow.}} ===Act VI - Flames of Heart=== {{Quest Description|The curtain has fallen on the grand competitions. Don your medal and travel onward to the Vale of Glory, where you shall make a decision that may change how the story goes.}} ===Act VII - Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens=== {{Quest Description|The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?}} ===Segue - Rust, Sword and the Sun=== {{Quest Description|While waiting for contact from the Ephor's Palace, you and Abby arrive at Solis Tavern, where you run into a blind wandering bard—Nestor. Having learned of the Ephor's invitation to the hunt, Nestor shares with you Augusta's stories before she rose to power.}} ===Act VIII - By Sun's Burning Hand=== {{Quest Description|As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...}} ===Act IX - By Moon's Fated Light=== {{Quest Description|With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.}} ===Act X - The Bygone Shall Always Return=== {{Quest Description|To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...}} ===Act XI - Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides=== {{Quest Description|With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...}} ===Segue Afterstory - A Stranger in A Strange Land=== {{Quest Description|In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few…}} ===Act XII - Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands=== {{Quest Description|A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.}} ===Segue - Flowing Starlight in the Iris=== {{Quest Description|After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.}} ==Navigation== {{Quest Navbox|Main Quests}} [[Category:Chapter II| ]] [[Category:Main Quests]]
